limitations: The original validation and test outcomes were examined before the GEARS extension.
The transductive GEARS graph uses held-out target identities and a public GO snapshot.
Only one GEARS seed was fitted; Epi-C3 has three flow seeds sharing one representation.
Inputs reuse controls and batches; this is not an independent donor or biological replicate.
GEARS and the training-mean comparator predict log expression, not direct count distributions.
